text: Colonoscopy Report: Near-obstructing circumferential mass identified in the descending colon at 25 cm from anal verge. Mass measures approximately 5 cm in length with irregular, ulcerated surface. Unable to pass scope beyond the lesion. Multiple biopsies obtained. No other polyps or masses identified in the visualized segments. IMPRESSION: Large descending colon mass, highly suspicious for malignancy. Recommend staging CT abdomen/pelvis and CEA level. Surgical consultation arranged.
